scope: Review only. V8 elapsed sample-delta weights are not exclusive CPU durations. Exclusive leaf samples and inclusive stack presence are reported separately; recursively repeated function identities count once inclusively per sample. All source positions use per-job transform source maps, zero-based V8 positions converted to one-based original lines/columns via GLB mapping. Unmapped project positions remain explicitly unmapped and excluded from original-source ranking. Active intervals require both current and previous sample stacks to descend from the named worker consume frame. Cutoffs 1/2/5ms are sensitivity diagnostics, NOT acceptance gates or unbiased CPU estimators; censoring excludes native/JIT/GC/scheduling gaps without distinguishing their cause.
